propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures are invisible in plan-review verdict JSON despite being logged as warnings, making run degradation undetectable by callers consuming the gate output

A new run-scoped contextvars sink in step_failures.py records each failed LLM call at the single runner exception seam and drains into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, preserving byte-identical output for clean runs

coverage.llm_step_failures is shaped {total: count, by_step: {label: count}} keyed by _call_label, matching grep-friendly log output, and is declared in plan_review_verdict.schema.json with text rendering in _render_plan_review_text
The sink is leaf-module observability only with no verdict, exit-code, or control-flow changes; every swallow site's existing behaviour and classification remain unchanged
Record site is activated once per gate run in plan-review scope alongside contract-violation collection, and drain is destructive to prevent leakage across runs in the same process
